contentText: What fate for Europe's Future Combat Air System? The joint program to renew military aviation in France, Germany and Spain has hit turbulence between various partners designing a common future jet - with questions over whether Berlin might quit the defence scheme altogether. Also in the show - Apple is sued over its alleged role in distributing child sexual abuse material, and the Trump administration threatens to quit the International Energy Agency over its net zero emissions goal.
